evidence.reason: `detectChecks` treats every `tsconfig.json` as a single-program `tsc-lines` check. For a solution-style config (`files: []` plus `references`), plain `tsc --noEmit` does not traverse the referenced projects, so the generated check does not check the referenced application source (and commonly fails with no inputs). This is an implementation defect in the generated check, not merely a request to add a new requirement.
